items.title: Mark Soskin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 17, 2021
items.q: So I went up to Bruce Lundvall, then the head of Columbia Records. I said, “Hey Bruce, they’re all all-stars and I’m not, so what are we going to do?”

ctx.x: Yeah, it seems to be challenging but you seem to have done all right.

Oh I have. You know I mean besides Sonny Rollins I played with well Stanley Turrentine, Billy Cobham, you know a bunch of people. And I saw that on one of your shows you had Orrin Keepnews, right? And Orrin was my first producer on my first record. Okay? So one thing led to another. I mean first what happened was that I was scheduled to play with the CBS All Stars, a group called the CBS All Stars and they were all all-stars and I wasn’t. So I went up to Bruce Lundvall, then the head of Columbia Records. I said,…
